title: C++ Operators
description: Arithmetic, comparison, logic, bit manipulation and the precedence rules that decide what a C++ expression actually means.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 算術、比較、邏輯、位元運算，以及決定 C++ 運算式真正意思的優先順序規則。

questions.prompt: What is the value of `7 / 2` when both operands are `int`?

prompt.zh-Hant: 當兩個運算元都是 `int` 時，`7 / 2` 的值是多少？

explanation.zh-Hant: 整數除法會丟棄小數部分（向零截斷），所以 7 / 2 是 3；要得到 3.5 必須至少一個運算元是浮點數。

questions.explanation: Integer division discards the fractional part (truncates toward zero), so 7 / 2 is 3. At least one operand must be floating point to get 3.5.

questions.prompt: In `a + b * c`, which operation is performed first?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 `a + b * c` 中，哪一個運算會先執行？

a.zh-Hant: b * c，因為 * 的優先順序高於 +

explanation.zh-Hant: * 的優先順序高於 +，所以先算 b * c，再把結果加 a；同級運算子才由左至右。

options.text: b * c, because * has higher precedence than +
a + b, because evaluation is left to right

questions.explanation: * binds tighter than +, so b * c is evaluated first and the result is added to a. Left-to-right applies only among operators of the same precedence.

questions.prompt: Given `int x = 5;`, what does the expression `x++` evaluate to?

prompt.zh-Hant: 已知 `int x = 5;`，運算式 `x++` 的值是多少？

explanation.zh-Hant: 後置 ++ 會先回傳舊值 5，再把 x 遞增為 6；前置 ++x 則先遞增再回傳 6。

questions.explanation: Postfix ++ yields the old value (5) and then increments x to 6. Prefix ++x increments first and yields 6.

explanation.zh-Hant: 5 是二進位 101，3 是 011；逐位元 AND 得 001，即十進位 1。

questions.explanation: 5 is 101 in binary and 3 is 011. Bitwise AND gives 001, which is 1.

questions.prompt: Which of these are logical operators in C++? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是 C++ 的邏輯運算子？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: &&、||、! 是邏輯運算子；& 是位元 AND，作用在整數的每個位元上。

questions.explanation: &&, || and ! are the logical operators. & is bitwise AND and works on each bit of an integer.

questions.prompt: Which statements about short-circuit evaluation are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於短路求值，下列敘述何者正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: `a && b` 在 a 為假時不會評估 b。

b.zh-Hant: `a || b` 在 a 為真時不會評估 b。

c.zh-Hant: 短路可以避免對空指標解引用。

d.zh-Hant: `&&` 與 `||` 一定會評估兩個運算元。

explanation.zh-Hant: && 左邊為假就整體為假，|| 左邊為真就整體為真，因此右邊可能不被評估；常用於 `p != nullptr && p->ok()`。

options.text: `a && b` does not evaluate b when a is false.
`a || b` does not evaluate b when a is true.
Short-circuiting can prevent dereferencing a null pointer.

questions.explanation: && stops when the left side is false and || stops when the left side is true, so the right side may never run. That is why `p != nullptr && p->ok()` is safe.

questions.prompt: In C++, `=` and `==` can be used interchangeably inside an `if` condition.

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 C++ 中，`=` 與 `==` 可以在 `if` 條件中互換使用。

explanation.zh-Hant: `=` 是賦值，`==` 是比較；`if (x = 5)` 會把 5 賦值給 x 並測試 5，幾乎總是錯誤。

questions.explanation: = assigns and == compares. `if (x = 5)` assigns 5 to x and then tests 5, which is almost always a bug.

questions.prompt: For an unsigned integer without overflow, `x << 1` is equivalent to multiplying x by 2.

prompt.zh-Hant: 在沒有溢出的情況下，對無號整數而言 `x << 1` 等同於把 x 乘以 2。

explanation.zh-Hant: 左移一位會把每個位元往高位移動，數值變成兩倍；若移出的高位超出型別範圍則會丟失。

questions.explanation: Shifting left by one moves every bit to a higher position, doubling the value. Bits shifted past the type's width are lost.

questions.prompt: The `%` operator returns the ____ of an integer division.

prompt.zh-Hant: `%` 運算子會回傳整數除法的 ____。

explanation.zh-Hant: % 是取餘數運算子：17 % 5 的結果是 2。

questions.explanation: % is the remainder operator: 17 % 5 evaluates to 2.

questions.prompt: Explain the difference between prefix `++x` and postfix `x++`.

prompt.zh-Hant: 說明前置 `++x` 與後置 `x++` 的分別。

model.zh-Hant: 前置 ++x 先遞增再回傳新值；後置 x++ 先回傳舊值再遞增。若只是把 x 加一而不使用運算式的值，兩者效果相同；前置版本通常可避免額外複製。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵在於運算式的值是何時的 x，以及副作用發生的先後。

answer.model: Prefix ++x increments x first and yields the new value. Postfix x++ yields the old value first and then increments x. When the result is discarded, both have the same effect, but prefix avoids the extra copy in some cases.

questions.explanation: The difference is when the value is read relative to the increment side effect.
